info.description: API for the Horpug dormitory management system.
info.title: Horpug API

get.summary: Get an activity log by ID

post.summary: Log in with username/email and password
Exchange the refresh token cookie for a new access/refresh token pair

get.description: Returns every dormitory for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only the dormitories the caller manages.

Returns active dormitories for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only the active dormitories the caller manages. Intended for populating dormitory selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.
Returns every room type for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only room types under dormitories the caller manages. Optionally filter by dormitory.

Returns active room types for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only the active room types under dormitories the caller manages. Intended for populating room type selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.

get.summary: Get a room type by ID

get.description: Returns active users. Intended for populating user selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.
